title: Goofy Ahh Running
blurb: Rubbery, frantic footsteps that make dignity structurally impossible. Cartoon sprint audio upgrades any chase into a circus act — the legs appear to be moving faster than the body, which is the whole illusion — and applying it to real footage does the same thing instantly. Play it over people running for buses they will not catch, dogs doing zoomies at eleven at night, and tactical retreats from responsibilities that will still be there tomorrow. Nobody has ever looked cool while this sound was playing, and that is the entire design goal.
origin: Cartoon sprint audio from the goofy ahh genre.
